name: Immendingen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Immendingen (a red lion on white above blue and white wavy bars).
history: Municipal flag of Immendingen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Immendingen arms — red lion over wavy bars
